Zhao Butou and Qin Shuang and A-ling shown in <Picture 1> keep the same face, hair, costume and props as the first frame; the set layout stays as it is. Constable Zhao speaks a short Mandarin line, 「那是你的事。人我帶來了，一個都不能少」, his lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable in natural talking mouth shapes; Zhao gives a cold smirk and takes one big step to the side, sweeping his arm toward the gateway so the two women stand revealed; Qin Shuang lifts her chin, A-ling keeps her eyes on the ground, both with their lips closed, and the bright near-noon sunlight stays unchanged. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. One continuous shot. Natural, realistic human motion of real actors; faces, hair and costumes stay as in the first frame.
